test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Stomach : Digestive system : : Kidney : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Stomach : Digestive system → The main organs that make up the **digestive system** are the mouth, esophagus, **stomach**, small intestine, large intestine, rectum and anus.

Similarly,

 
• Kidney : ? → The main organs that make up the **excretory system** are **kidney**, ureter, urinary bladder and urethra. Kidneys filter the blood and urine is the filtrate obtained.

Hence, '**Excretory system**' is the correct answer.
